description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for approval client logic within a plugin SDK, including configuration resolution, approval target checks, and request handling logic.

methods.name: defaultNormalizeSenderId
methods.description: Trims the input string and returns it or undefined if empty.

methods.name: isApprovalTargetsMode
methods.description: Checks if the approval configuration mode is 'targets' or 'both'.

methods.name: isChannelExecApprovalClientEnabledFromConfig
methods.description: Determines if the approval client is enabled based on config and approver count.

methods.name: isChannelExecApprovalTargetRecipient
methods.description: Checks if a given sender and channel match approval target criteria based on config.

methods.name: createChannelExecApprovalProfile
methods.description: Creates an approval profile object with methods to determine client enablement, approver status, target resolution, request handling, and prompt suppression.
